_comment: Market-data feed for the investor-relations ticker.
apiToken is intentionally a Cloud Manager secret reference, not a literal. Committing a
market-data token would put a licensed, billable credential in Git history. Set the
secret in Cloud Manager under the name AEROVANCE_STOCK_API_TOKEN, per environment.
cacheSeconds must stay at or above whatever the market-data agreement requires for
delayed quotes — 900s is the usual 15 minutes. Lowering it is a licensing decision,
